about: The disclosure rule table as shipped, frozen. The POC numbers quoted in docs/04 were computed from this table; changing it invalidates them until they are re-measured.

rules.policy: credentials are never stored, not even as a card
identifiers that are regulated by form: email, phone, card, postal address, account
body, diagnosis, medication, diet, exercise, measurements
